title: [Mouse Without Borders] Add haptic feedback after control transfer

status.label: Owned haptics implementation tracker
status.detail: The assigned Mouse Without Borders tracker is scoped under #48761 and depends on #50162.

next_action.label: Post accepted-transfer note
next_action.reason: Feedback must represent destination acceptance, not an attempted or pending transfer.

comment.body: This assigned Mouse Without Borders tracker should consume #50162 for parent #48761. Please emit one Grow pulse only after the destination device accepts pointer control; attempted, pending, failed, or rejected transfers must not produce success-shaped feedback, and an established connection must not repeat it.

judgment.rationale: The issue is already assigned and precisely scoped as part of the known haptics implementation set.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to niels9001.
It references parent #48761 and shared infrastructure #50162.
Acceptance criteria require one Grow pulse only after a successful cross-device control transfer.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a coordination note preserving destination acceptance as the success boundary.
